Job Description:
LIQUID WA HOLDINGS PTY LTD T/As CELLARBRATIONS ARMADALE, located in Armadale , WA 6112 , is seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to join our team on a full-time basis. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and a wide range of retail and beverage products to our valued customers.

Position: Retail Manager
Location: Armadale WA 6112
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary Range: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum (based on experience)

About the Role:

As the Retail Manager, you will oversee the daily operations of the bottle shop to ensure smooth and efficient functionality, optimal sales performance, and exceptional customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day store operations, including retail and stock control.
Monitor and maintain inventory levels; coordinate and receive stock deliveries.
Prepare and publish weekly rosters for staff based on sales forecasts, skill levels, and availability.
Ensure labour costs align with business targets and make adjustments as needed.
Plan and execute weekly orders and in-store promotions.
Manage and reduce product waste through efficient ordering and storage practices.
Analyse sales data and forecast future sales trends.
Address and resolve customer queries, feedback, and complaints professionally.

About You:

Minimum 2-3 year of experience as a Retail Manager or in a similar role.
Strong leadership, organisational, and communication skills.
Proven ability to manage staff, meet KPIs, and deliver great customer service.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
If this sounds like you and you’re ready to take the next step in your retail management career, apply now and join the Cellarbrations Armadale!

Your Role
Join our dynamic cross-functional team at our newly established airconditioned, automated facility!

As an Operator Maintainer, your primary responsibility will be to ensure seamless operations by promptly addressing system faults of both technical and operational nature, thereby contributing to our continued business growth.

Your tasks will include:
Monitoring, operating, and troubleshooting faults in automated material handling equipment within a fast-paced production environment.
Efficiently resolving machine faults using logical problem-solving techniques, even at heights of up to 30 meters while adhering to safety protocols.
Utilizing literacy, numeracy, and IT skills to interpret and maintain data and fault information accurately.
Upholding high standards of housekeeping and hygiene.
Collaborating with the maintenance team to ensure the machines remain in optimal condition and promptly reporting any anomalies.
Strict adherence to safety guidelines to maintain a secure working environment for all staff.

Who are you?
Demonstrate a commitment to safety, meticulous attention to detail, and effective problem-solving skills.
Have a genuine interest in automation and technology, coupled with a willingness to learn new concepts and procedures.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across different teams.
Willingness and ability to work rotating shifts, including days, evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
Ability to accurately identify colors such as red, blue, white, yellow, and green.

Meet physical fitness requirements, including frequent walking, climbing, lifting up to 25kgs unassisted, and working at heights of up to 30 meters (with appropriate training and safety gear provided).

Are you a hands-on leader who enjoys building relationships, improving systems, leading people and driving business growth?    WA's fastest-growing battery recycling businesses, providing safe, compliant and environmentally responsible battery collection solutions to businesses across Perth, the Southwest and some of WA's leading mining companies, is looking for their Ops & Growth Manager.    Following the establishment of thier facility in 2025, they've experienced more than 30% annual growth and are now seeking an Operations & Growth Manager to help drive the next stage of our journey.    This is a unique opportunity to join a growing business where your ideas, leadership and initiative will directly influence future success.   
 What's on Offer? 
 ? $120,000 + Super    ? Fully maintained Amarok Ute    ? Monday-Friday | 8am-4pm    ? Flexible working arrangements    ? Leadership role with genuine autonomy    ? Growing business operating in a booming industry    ? Opportunity to build and lead your own team    ? Be part of the circular economy and environmental sustainability sector   
 About the Role 
 Reporting directly to the Owner, this newly created leadership position combines operations management, team leadership and business development.    You'll play a key role in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations while helping expand customer base across Perth and Southwest WA.    Your responsibilities will include:   
 
 Leading and supporting a team of operational staff   
 Managing customer relationships and ensuring service excellence   
 Coordinating logistics, scheduling and battery collection operations   
 Developing and implementing operational systems and procedures   
 Supporting WHS, compliance and quality initiatives   
 Monitoring fleet movements and operational performance   
 Preparing quotations, proposals and customer solutions   
 Identifying and pursuing new business opportunities   
 Supporting marketing initiatives and industry events   
 Working closely with the Owner to drive continued growth   
 
 About You 
 You may currently be working as an:   
 
 Operations Manager   
 Service Manager   
 Branch Manager   
 Logistics Manager   
 Waste Management Supervisor   
 Depot Manager   
 Business Development Manager   
 Operations Supervisor   
 
 To succeed, you'll bring:   
 
 Previous leadership or people management experience   
 Strong organisational and planning skills   
 Excellent communication and customer relationship abilities   
 Commercial awareness and business development capability   
 Strong administrative and computer skills   
 Experience within logistics, transport, waste management, industrial services or similar industries   
 Permanent Australian working rights   
 
 Most importantly, you'll be proactive, solutions-focused and excited by the opportunity to grow with a business that is making a real difference.    This isn't a corporate environment where decisions take months and good ideas get lost in red tape.    You'll work directly alongside the owner, have a genuine say in how the business operates, and help shape the future of a company operating in one of Australia's fastest-growing environmental sectors.    If you're looking for a role that offers variety, responsibility, leadership and long-term growth, we'd love to hear from you.     Additional Requirements    
 
 Proof of right to work in Australia   
 Pre-employment medical, including drug & alcohol screening   
 Pre-employment police check   
 
   How to Apply  Click the  "Apply Now"  button or email your resume directly to:  Katy.Fitzpatrick@Programmed.com.au        

  Who we are  
 As one of Australia's largest employers, we work with great companies all around Australia and New Zealand to give you the best opportunities to work when and where you want to. 
 At Programmed, we are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment which values and respects diverse styles, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

- Join the team at Watheroo Rural Traders

JC Agri Services Pty Ltd, trading as Watheroo Rural Traders, is a trusted rural merchandise and agricultural services business supporting farming communities throughout Watheroo and the surrounding Wheatbelt region of Western Australia. We are committed to providing quality products, reliable service, and practical solutions to our customers across the agricultural sector.

As our business continues to grow, we are seeking a motivated and experienced Retail Manager to join our team and contribute to our ongoing success.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Direct daily operations, executive decision-making, and P&L performance for the Watheroo Rural Traders branch to maximize efficiency and sustainable business profitability.
- Lead agribusiness engagement strategies and spearheads high-value trade contract negotiations with key agricultural stakeholders to maximize revenue streams.
- Manage comprehensive inventory control, strategic procurement forecasting, and the critical logistical execution of direct, on-farm product deliveries.
- Conducts regular on-farm field visits to inspect crop health, analyze growing conditions, and collect soil samples to deliver highly accurate, tailored diagnostic advice for crop protection and yield optimization.
- Provide expert in-store and in-field technical counsel on agricultural inputs while serving as the primary conduit to professional agronomy consultants for specialized support.
- Execute advanced project management and market analysis, tracking competitor pricing and regional agribusiness trends to maintain a distinct competitive advantage.
- Enforce absolute compliance with strict health, safety, and environmental regulations across both the retail environment and complex off-site farm logistics.
- Drive targeted regional marketing campaigns and community engagement initiatives tailored specifically to the local farming sector to expand market share.
- Govern the comprehensive branch budget, analyzing financial reports and implementing rigorous cost-control measures to optimize the bottom line.
- Manage staff performance and implements rigorous training programs focused on sophisticated agronomic product knowledge and premium service standards.
- Resolve high-stakes client grievances and supply chain bottlenecks regarding high-value rural products to preserve vital long-term trust.

To be considered for this position, you will need to demonstrate:
- Diploma in Retail Management or a related business qualification.
- Minimum of 3 years experience in retail leadership in agriculture supplies and services, rural trade operations and agricultural business management.
- Excellent communication skills, teamwork, customer centric approach and the ability to grow the business independently.
- Current forklift and Agsafe certificates
 -Current unrestricted HR and C vehicle licence essential
 -SAP experience - 2 years at least
- Current First Aid Certificate

A competitive remuneration package will be offered to the successful candidate.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 






We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 






As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 






Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


Are you currently part of the team at Monash Health? Use your network login to access the Monash Health Careers portal and discover all the job opportunities open to you, to support growing your career within the organisation.




To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.









Shape Digital Healthcare. Drive Innovation. Improve Lives. 












About the Department of Clinical Informatics 






The Department of Clinical Informatics is where healthcare and technology come together to transform patient care. 






Established in 2025, we bring together clinical, digital and innovation expertise to shape the future of healthcare across Monash Health. Our multidisciplinary team spans Nursing, Medical, Allied Health and Community Informatics, Digital Clinical Learning and Change, Artificial Intelligence, Consumer Informatics, User Experience and Clinical Coding. 






The Department is committed to building a high-performing team and improving patient outcomes through digital innovation, aligned with the Monash Health Strategic Plan and Digital & Data Plan. 






If you're passionate about innovation, collaboration and using technology to make a real difference in healthcare, this newly created full-time, ongoing role offers the chance to help shape the future from the ground up. 












About the Role 






This ground-breaking role is designed to enable our clinical teams to readily and safely transform patient care, using digital technologies. Intersecting with clinical practice, digital health, change management and workplace capability building, this is a rare opportunity to lead the transition of our clinicians, in all professional streams, to embrace the benefits of a digitally thinking workplace. 






Far from a "Business As Usual" role, this opportunity will suit individuals seeking to leverage strategic leadership and advice to engineer a significant change in the way we deliver patient care. Acknowledging the rapid rate of change in the digital space, you are not deterred by uncertainty. If appointed, you will relish the chance to apply your innovative thinking skills to build diverse, agile, high performing teams. 






As a key member of our Clinical Informatics leadership team, your success will be measured across three key result areas: 









Leadership of change of learning functions and practices 












Collaboration with Clinical Informatics and Digital and Information Division 












Stakeholder engagement and relationship development 









You'll appreciate that the collaborative nature of this role will see you working on site at least three days per week, with flexible working arrangements available. With accountability for the function across the whole of organisation, travel across Monash Health will be required. 












About You 






You have a keen understanding of informatics as well as demonstrated knowledge of adult learning principles. Described as visionary, you also have the ability to translate organisational objectives into practical and effective practices that advance care at the operational level. 






You are comfortable working with ambiguity. Your emotional intelligence equips you with the skills and strategies to navigate the challenges of change respectfully, professionally and sensitively, adapting your style to meet the needs of varying audiences. 






Our clinical teams are highly skilled, busy and saturated with information. Your job will be to enhance their Joy in Work through equipping them with a relevant, digitally-enabled approach that will see them continue to deliver consistently high standards of care in the community we serve. 



What you need 






Your ability to engage and influence effectively across a range of professional groups, pivoting seamlessly between clinical, technical and strategic perspectives, will be key to your success. 






To be considered for this role, you'll need to demonstrate: 









Deep clinical systems expertise and success leading enterprise change 












Strategic leadership of integrated change and learning functions to drive enterprise-wid digitatl transformation 












Intimate appreciation of transformation as it relates to building digital capability 












Expertise in adult learning, enabling success driving digital adoption and optimisation 












Awareness of digital architecture and how systems communicate, share, exchange and use data 












Detailed knowledge of clinical safety and risk management 












Data and information fluency 









Current Ahpra registration, a postgraduate qualification in Digital Health, Informatics, Learning-Education, Change Management and-or leadership are required. 












Why join Monash Health? 






This is more than a digital role-it's your chance to transform healthcare at scale. Working at the intersection of clinical care, technology and innovation, you'll help create smarter digital solutions that improve patient outcomes and support the clinicians who deliver them every day 












At Monash Health, you will: 









Lead a state-wide service with real impact 












Work within a values-driven, purpose-led organisation 












Be part of a connected network of clinical, academic and system leaders 












Help drive innovation, inclusion and better health outcomes 















We offer: 









The opportunity to make a real impact on patient experience 












A supportive, collaborative team environment 












Ongoing learning and development opportunities 












The chance to be part of Victoria's largest public health service













For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Anthony Pham, Deputy Chief Nursing and Midwifery Information Officer on 0435 968 584.

Technical Writer contract opportunity for a state gov department   Your new company    Join a large Queensland-based public sector organisation delivering a significant business transformation program aimed at improving governance, financial management, asset lifecycle management, and project delivery capability. Supporting a substantial infrastructure portfolio and investment program, this transformation initiative will establish stronger frameworks, processes, and controls to enhance organisational performance and long-term service delivery outcomes.    Your new role     
 As the Technical Writer, you will play a key role in developing, editing, and maintaining controlled documentation across a major transformation program. Working closely with subject matter experts, project teams, and senior stakeholders, you will translate complex technical, financial, and operational information into clear, accessible, and user-friendly documentation. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Developing and maintaining governance, planning, assurance, and project management documentation. 
 Creating process maps, templates, guidance materials, procedures, checklists, and knowledge resources. 
 Preparing financial management documentation, reporting tools, and user guidance materials. 
 Writing, reviewing, and editing technical documentation to a publishable standard. 
 Assisting with executive briefing papers, reports, and business improvement documentation. 
 Producing stakeholder communications, training materials, and change management resources. 
 Conducting quality assurance reviews and maintaining version-controlled document repositories. 
 Collaborating with subject matter experts to define documentation requirements and ensure content accuracy. 
 Promoting documentation standards and continuous improvement across the program. 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate: 
 
 Extensive experience as a Technical Writer, Documentation Specialist, or similar role within complex project or program environments. 
 Strong experience developing, editing, and maintaining high-quality technical and business documentation. 
 Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to communicate complex information to non-technical audiences. 
 Experience producing governance, process, policy, framework, reporting, or project-related documentation. 
 Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills. 
 Proven ability to manage competing priorities and deliver quality outcomes within tight timeframes. 
 Experience working collaboratively with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, and project teams. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to contribute to a high-profile business transformation program. 
 Exposure to complex governance, financial management, and infrastructure initiatives. 
 Collaborative and supportive team environment. 
 The chance to work alongside senior stakeholders and subject matter experts across multiple business functions. 
 A rewarding contract opportunity where your work will have a direct impact on program delivery, organisational capability, and long-term business improvement outcomes.
